title: SupeRR Intelligence Analytics & Machine Learning Methodology

pillars.name: Pressure Intensity P(t)
pillars.description: Dynamic logistic chase pressure bounded strictly in [0, 10] computed prior to delivery.

pillars.name: Runs Above Expected (RAE)
pillars.description: Context-adjusted delivery residual evaluated against neutral baseline.

pillars.name: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage & Uncertainty
pillars.formula: theta_i = (1 - B_i) * ybar_i + B_i * mu_0,  SE_i = sqrt(1 / (1/tau^2 + 1/sigma_i^2))
pillars.description: Independently shrinks small-sample noisy batting and bowling estimates toward discipline priors.

pillars.name: Evidence-Based Discipline Ranking (LCB)
pillars.formula: Score_i = theta_i - 0.5 * SE_i  (Eligible only if Sample >= Threshold)
pillars.description: Requires verified sample size (High: 180+ balls / 12+ matches; Med: 60+ balls / 5+ matches). Ineligible players receive N/A and are excluded from official rankings.

pillars.name: Discovery Gap (Undervalued Talent)
pillars.description: Identifies players whose context-adjusted value significantly exceeds raw superficial statistics.
